reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "promtail: chore(promtail): Improve default configuration that is shipped with rpm/deb packages to avoid possible high CPU utilisation if there are lots of…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The shipped default promtail config for rpm/deb packages changed to avoid possible high CPU use with many files in /var/log; the evidence does not state any failure.
